records.meaning: One immutable program identity, version, exact owner-selection binding, dependency graph, mode policy, effect ceiling, and authority ceiling.
One work request selecting a program, evaluation mode, root dependency IDs, and any exact observed digests intentionally selected for candidate construction.
One deterministic no-effect evaluation containing the closed dependency set, observed and expected digests, ambient observations, blockers, and PASS, CANDIDATE, BLOCK, or NOT_EVALUABLE result.
Evaluate only explicitly selected root dependencies and their declared transitive closure; all other drift is ambient diagnostic evidence.
Admitted-use requires registered digests; candidate construction may use changed bytes only when the request names their exact observed digest, and can never return an active allow.
Candidate exact binding from the generated system ontology to the Rust library and CLI under runtime/.

Preserve explicit selection, transitive closure, path containment, deterministic selector extraction, relevant-versus-ambient separation, candidate non-activation, fail-closed ambiguity, and zero effect authority.

residue.meaning: No owner activation binds an exact program, kernel binary, scope, route, and effect mapping.
Append-only crash-safe evidence storage belongs to implementation Layer 2 and is not required for the initial deterministic kernel proof.
Root routing remains in explicit enforcement suspension until an accepted Rust baseline and separate activation decision exist.
